bio: Q.B. Bistró is a small, welcoming venue in the heart of Cuneo’s historic centre, overlooking a quiet, secluded street. The kitchen looks to the contemporary with dishes that are essential yet thoughtful, built upon seasonal ingredients and carefully selected raw materials. The considered and well-structured wine list opens its gaze willingly to natural and organic bottles, with labels that tell stories of terroirs and independent producers. A youthful and pleasing establishment, ideal for those seeking simplicity, attention to detail and an authentic measure of passion.
